name: Lands
description: Claim chunks and trust friends. Your first land costs $500 (/lands create, includes a free 3x3), and extra chunks are $25 each. Upkeep is $5 per chunk per day; an active land that can't pay goes into debt instead of losing chunks (/upkeep). Nations and land wars are off this season.

name: FrontierReputation
description: In-house. Cowboy reputation system. Pacifist knockout, wanted outlaws, lawman badge, cash bounties, daily login streaks.

name: FrontierEvents
description: In-house. Boss Rush raids, the Gauntlet, raid keys, TDM/FFA/KOTH arena PvP, duel tournaments, Colosseum Night, the open PvP ring, Pit difficulty, Pitforged loot. /event opens the hub.

name: FrontierShop
description: In-house. Server shop with daily-ticker pricing, a player market, sign shops, daily deals and a weekly black market, plus land upkeep and debt. /shop, /market and /upkeep.

name: mcMMO
description: 19 skills with passive bonuses and active abilities. Full version, no lite mode.

name: FrontierGraves
description: In-house. Dying drops your inventory into a grave. Never decays on a timer — it despawns the moment it's emptied.

name: FrontierHeads
description: In-house. Player heads drop from PvP kills only. Trophies for actual fights.

name: FrontierBorder
description: In-house. World border grows daily from combined playtime, scaled to active-player count. Also sets the server timezone.

name: FrontierTab
description: In-house. Custom tab list with session/all-time playtime, deaths, ping, and server TPS (ticks per second; 20 is smooth). Feeds the playtime data the border expansion reads.

name: FrontierStatsAPI
description: In-house. Local HTTP server feeding this website's live leaderboards, border status, shop catalog and wanted list.

name: FrontierMail
description: In-house. Send messages or items to offline players. Both arrive on their next login.

name: FrontierTrade
description: In-house. Two-window trade GUI between players. Both sides confirm before items swap, and any change un-confirms both.

name: FrontierEnderTracker
description: In-house. Tracks who actually damaged the Ender Dragon. Live sidebar during the fight, ranked leaderboard when it dies.

name: FrontierEndLock
description: In-house. Keeps the End closed so nobody solos the Dragon in week one. It opens on its own on Saturday, Oct 10 at 5 PM Arizona, with countdown broadcasts on the way.

name: FrontierNetherLock
description: In-house. Same idea for the Nether — an optional stone-age opening week.

name: FrontierBackup
description: In-house. Scheduled zipped world backups on a rolling window.

name: FrontierAnnouncements
description: In-house. Rotating chat tips with a per-player mute, the /help menu (also /commands), the Frontier Gazette, and an optional weekly Market Day (off on mc.pvpers.us, where the market is a permanent stall area at spawn).

name: CoreProtect
description: Block logging and rollback. Grief protection and investigation tool.

name: LuckPerms
description: Group-based permissions for staff and rep tiers.

name: EssentialsX
description: Core server commands: /home, /tpa, /back, /msg, and more. Also provides the economy the shop and events pay out in.

name: BlueMap
description: Live web-based world map at map.pvpers.us with real-time player positions and claim outlines.

name: Simple Voice Chat
description: Proximity voice chat. Hear nearby players, fade out at range. Walkie-talkies and group channels supported. Client mod required (pre-installed in both modpacks).
